warning: Every voice here comes from the public Voice Library. A free plan cannot use library voices through the API at all (HTTP 402 paid_plan_required), whatever the character balance says, so a paid plan is required before any of these can be heard. Adding one to the account is a separate account change: see scripts/add-shared-voice.mjs.
selection_basis: Metadata against the voice brief only. No audio has been heard. NOTE: none of the 20 library Kannada voices is verified for Kannada. All are verified for Hindi or English, on turbo_v2_5 / flash_v2_5 / multilingual_v2, none of which supports Kannada, and none is verified against v3. Treat every entry here as an unverified claim to speak Kannada.

shortlist.name: Padhma - Calm Kannada Audiobook
shortlist.v3_risk: Assume a Professional Voice Clone, which is documented as weaker on v3. v3 is the only model that speaks Kannada.
shortlist.why_shortlisted: Audiobook register is the closest thing in the library to long-form documentary narration, and high_quality is the safer category on v3. Female, matching the brief primary.

shortlist.name: Sharadhi - Natural Kannada Conversation
shortlist.v3_risk: Assume a Professional Voice Clone, which is documented as weaker on v3. v3 is the only model that speaks Kannada.
shortlist.why_shortlisted: Female, high_quality, described as natural rather than performed. Conversational register is the risk to listen for.

shortlist.name: Aisiri - Warm Kannada Narration
shortlist.v3_risk: Assume a Professional Voice Clone, which is documented as weaker on v3. v3 is the only model that speaks Kannada.
shortlist.why_shortlisted: The single best description against the brief: warm Kannada narration, well paced. Held third only because it is a Professional Voice Clone and those are documented as weaker on v3.

shortlist.why_shortlisted: Male alternative. Described as trusting the story enough not to perform it, which is exactly the brief. high_quality.

category_note: library_category is the Voice Library quality tier and does NOT indicate clone type: Padhma reads high_quality there and professional once added to the account. account_category is the real clone type and is only known once a voice is added. Assume professional, which ElevenLabs documents as weaker on v3, until an account_category says otherwise.
